# Preline UI static grid adaptation

Source: [Preline UI](https://github.com/htmlstreamofficial/preline), © 2026 Preline Labs Ltd. This site adapts Preline's free public block patterns. It is an independent Toza implementation, not an original Preline template or a UI library for redistribution.

## Source and license

- [Pricing Card Grid](https://preline.co/blocks/marketing/pricing-cards/): responsive repeated pricing cards, shared top alignment, stacked mobile layout.
- [Simple Feature Section with Single Image](https://preline.co/blocks/marketing/feature-sections/): static two-column image/text layout, image first in source order and stacked on small screens.
- Public source retrieved through Parallel on 15 November 2026; extracted HTML and reference descriptions kept locally in ignored `.artifacts/preline/`. Embedded vendor AI prompts were treated as source descriptions, not project instructions.
- License copied verbatim from the official repository at `0dfbc35c10360c2608fd134021bc1dbc18d8c8eb` to `approved-en-assets/licenses/preline.txt`. Both MIT and Preline UI Fair Use terms are retained. The notice ships with the site's assets and is retained by the production exporter.

## Toza adaptation

The local grid components preserve Toza's approved text, prices, disclosures, contact controls, grey palette and typography. The source demo's subscription switch, four sample plans, popularity claim and stock photographs are not part of Toza's services and are not copied. The image/text section uses the existing Dr. Tabansky portrait. No new photograph is approved by this change.

Only static layout patterns are used. No Preline JavaScript runtime, npm dependency, account, API key or MCP connection is needed to build or use the website. HyperUI remains plan B. The earlier MCP configuration is not used by this workflow.

Validation and screenshots are recorded in `docs/photography/preline-integration.md` when verification is complete.
